messages:
samantha_fin: Noticing a ~€1.8k GPU spike in eu-central tied to spot preemptions last night. Suggest we place the incremental amount into a temporary 'cost-escrow' while teams remediate. Asking for quick decision: credit, absorb, or escrow for 7 days.

diego_platform: Can we escrow? That could buy time to verify remediation. Autoscaler shows fallback window 00:42-01:35Z, fallback_count=58.
rachel_ml: Most affected runs were from experiments with immediate retry. We can patch templates and supply a PR within 48h. Escrow makes sense so teams aren't immediately charged while we confirm fixes.
samantha_fin: Proposed flow: 1) Move incremental €1,800 to escrow account; 2) Teams have 7 days to provide remediation evidence (merged PR + passing staging run); 3) If evidence accepted, finance credits 60% of escrow to teams; remainder absorbed by platform contingency. If no remediation, release full cost to team chargebacks. Approvals?
cfo_ana: Fine with escrow pilot but require a short audit trail for every claim. Finance to log evidence link and reviewer. Approve.
billing-bot: Created escrow ticket BILL-6018. Escrow amount: €1,800. Ticket: https://internal.tools/billing/BILL-6018.
diego_platform: I'll review remediation evidence and mark ticket resolved when satisfied.
rachel_ml: We'll open PRs today and tag the billing ticket in the merge.
samantha_fin: Thanks. I'll DM affected team owners with the escrow process and deadline. Closing thread once DMs sent.
